evidence.blocks: DERIVED: ceil(2500 kW / 30 kW) = 84 blocks, 2.52 MW / 5.04 MWh; MW-scale interconnection unconfirmed
evidence.block_kw: CONFIRMED: REON Na+ EBS public rating, 30 kW
evidence.block_kwh: CONFIRMED: REON Na+ EBS public rating, 60 kWh
evidence.cells_per_block: ASSUMED: 120 cells inferred using 3.1 V and approximately 161 Ah; not an EBS specification
evidence.dc_floor_v: ASSUMED: 280-350 V implies a suitable block DC/DC stage; 750 V direct-input counterexample
evidence.n_min: ASSUMED: 10% of 120 cells may be bypassed before voltage limit
evidence.r_on_ohm: ASSUMED: 0.1 mOhm per active cell switch path; REON value unavailable
evidence.weak_factor: ASSUMED: one weak cell per block with 80-100% of normal capacity; stress case, not prevalence estimate
evidence.capacity_cov: LIT: 1.15% initial spread from TUM Na-ion cells, not REON EBS measurements
evidence.voltage: LIT/ASSUMED: representative Na-ion OCV shape with 0.5C linear overpotential; not measured EBS cells

economics.note: Team-sheet price hurdle, not a simulated EBS annual revenue forecast. A single discharge cannot establish annual ISO-NE peak savings.
